narrative.overview: The app borrows the Thai Department of Health food-guide flag: an inverted triangle of food groups. Here the flag is personal: its bands are nutrients sized from the person's own targets, filling as weighed food is logged. Everything else is a calm, standard mobile tool.
keyCharacteristics: One signature: the inverted-triangle flag on Today; every other screen is plain, familiar mobile UI.
Flat, unmodulated band colours from the food-guide flag; no gradients, no glass.
Scale contrast carries hierarchy: one giant number per screen, small labels.
Every number can be traced to its source.

rules.name: The Pressable Colour Rule
rules.body: Action Leaf appears only on things you can press or the current selection.

rules.name: The Band Colour Rule
rules.body: Band colours belong to the flag and its nutrients; they never decorate other components.

rules.name: The Held Change Rule
rules.body: A changed weekly target sits in a notice-yellow strip until the person taps รับทราบ.

dos: Do keep one giant number per screen and let labels stay small.
Do show where a number comes from, in plain Thai.
Do label estimates as ประมาณ.
donts: Don't add calorie rings, progress rings or stacks of same-size cards.
Don't use band colours for decoration.
Don't use a modal where an inline panel works.
